# Does your trust account three-way reconcile?

> Free IOLTA / client trust account three-way reconciliation for solo lawyers: paste your trust journal and bank balance to check bank vs journal vs client ledgers, negative client balances, uncleared funds, stale checks and commingling. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
